title.en: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Fees for Replacement or Certified Copy of Licence) Notification 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。其中 1 条为官方正文中标注的已废止条文存根（照录）。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Fees for Replacement or Certified Copy of Licence) Notification 2022 and comes into operation on 1 January 2023.

2. In this Notification, “GST” means the goods and services tax chargeable under the Goods and Services Tax Act 1993, and where it is chargeable, GST is calculated based on the rate in force at the time the goods or services are supplied.

heading.en: Fee for replacement or certified copy of harbour craft licence under Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Harbour Craft) Regulations

text.en:
3. The following fees are payable under the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Harbour Craft) Regulations (Rg 3):
(a)for a replacement of a licence under regulation 7(1)(c) of those Regulations — $5.45 (inclusive of GST);
[S 862/2023 wef 01/01/2024]
(b)for a certified copy of a licence under regulation 7(1)(e) of those Regulations — $5.45 (inclusive of GST).
[S 862/2023 wef 01/01/2024]

heading.en: Fee for replacement of manning licence under Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Harbour Craft Manning Licence Examination) Regulations

text.en:
4. The fee payable for the grant of a replacement licence under regulation 18(3) of the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Harbour Craft Manning Licence Examination) Regulations (Rg 4) is $10.90 (inclusive of GST).
[S 862/2023 wef 01/01/2024]

heading.en: Fee for replacement of licences under Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Pleasure Craft) Regulations

text.en:
5. The following fees are payable under the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Pleasure Craft) Regulations (Rg 6):
(a)for the replacement of a licence under regulation 4(1)(c) of those Regulations — $5.45 (inclusive of GST);
[S 862/2023 wef 01/01/2024]
(b)for the replacement of a driving licence under regulation 42 of those Regulations — $10.90 (inclusive of GST).
[S 862/2023 wef 01/01/2024]
